key_insight: Using higher-dimensional quantum units called qudits can increase information capacity per carrier and naturally encode high-dimensional systems for quantum simulation.
engineering_relevance: Qudits offer a route to extracting more processing capability from a fixed number of physical carriers, provided their additional levels can be reliably controlled and measured.
method: Review experimental progress in qudit preparation, control, and measurement across five hardware platforms.
Survey early demonstrations of qudit-based simulation, computation, and error suppression.
Outline challenges and future directions for scalable qudit processing.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports high-fidelity experimental progress and early application demonstrations, but provides no numerical benchmarks or comparative performance data.
watch_item: Higher information capacity does not eliminate decoherence or the need for fault tolerance, and scalable multilevel control remains a challenge.
paper_title: Quditology: harnessing many levels for quantum information processing
